vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
There are two different ways your company could be named:

- **As a paid ad:** U.S. businesses can apply to advertise through [OpenAI Ads Manager](https://ads.openai.com/). Eligibility depends on the type of product or service and OpenAI’s ad policies; some regulated categories face extra restrictions or review. Ads are labeled and separate from ChatGPT’s organic answers, and they don’t make ChatGPT recommend your company.
- **In an organic answer or search result:** There’s no official way to pay or submit your company to guarantee a mention. Any public website may be surfaced, but whether it is depends on the user’s question and what information ChatGPT can find. To make your site eligible for ChatGPT Search, allow OpenAI’s `OAI-SearchBot` in your `robots.txt` and make sure your hosting provider permits its traffic.

So, if you mean “who can buy a placement,” U.S. businesses that meet the ad requirements can apply. If you mean “who can ensure ChatGPT recommends my company,” nobody can guarantee that.
